checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Output is about 640x384, still wide, not 1:1.
Looks like the same white sneaker, though it was regenerated with slightly altered details.
Toe, heel and sole are all visible.
The sneaker is not obviously stretched, though it is smaller and its shape is slightly changed.

must.item: Floor and background match source, no added text or decorative elements
must.why: The scene was regenerated: the left side items changed, the floor is more reflective, and there is a new shadow. The background is not identical to the source.

faults.what: Output is not square; it is still a wide 5:3 image, so the core request failed.
The scene was regenerated rather than extended: the sneaker is resized and repositioned, and the left clutter and floor differ from the source.
The assistant claimed a square image was delivered, which is inaccurate.

summary: The output is still a wide, non-square image with the scene regenerated and altered, so the square-crop request failed.
